predictionDemo.disclaimer: The metrics above come from the included synthetic report. The chart and weights below are separate visual examples, not inference, calibrated confidence or SHAP attributions.
predictionDemo.confidenceNote: No calibrated confidence is available for this student.
predictionDemo.factorsSubtitle: Illustrative weights, not explanations computed for this student.
predictionDemo.weightsNote: Illustrative relative weights (total: 100%). Not probability points, causal effects or calculated SHAP contributions; the same factor example is kept when switching students.
predictionDemo.noExample: This record has no demonstration scenario. Simulated probabilities are not generated for real students.
predictionDemo.humanReview: The teacher decides on support after reviewing actual metrics and context.
predictionDemo.handoffNote: Source: predictive demonstration. Only the student is selected; no simulated percentages or weights are saved. Choose your action, priority and notes, and confirm human review.

impact.title: EduPulse Impact Lab
impact.subtitle: Turn a warning signal into reviewed support and shared learning.
impact.compareHelp: Select one or more options. Deselect an option to discard it before approval. Adapt resources and duration to your school.
impact.primaryAction: The first selected option is the main plan category. Combinations are retained in its evaluation.
impact.scenarioNotice: Illustrative scenario: you choose the targets. There is no validated model estimating these interventions’ effects. This is not a prediction or a guaranteed improvement.
impact.targetsNotEvidence: Targets are explored on screen only. They are not saved as observations and do not change student records.
impact.objective: Objective and actions adapted to the student
impact.review: I have reviewed the context, support options, feasibility and notes. I approve this plan under my professional responsibility.
impact.invalid: Select at least one option, enter 1–52 weeks, complete the objective and notes, and confirm your review.
impact.saveError: Could not save. Check your connection and try again. The change has not been confirmed.
impact.observedNotice: An observed difference does not show that the support caused it. Other factors may contribute; there is no control group or causal estimate.
impact.participationProxy: Participation is approximated by the percentage of assignments submitted. This does not measure all classroom participation.
impact.noFollowups: No follow-up observations yet. The baseline retains the indicators available when the plan was linked.
impact.chartLabel: Observed trend: attendance and assignments on the 0–100% axis; grade on the 0–10 axis. The same data is available in the table.
impact.history: Indicator history · attendance and assignments 0–100%; grade 0–10
impact.manualObservation: Enter verified data and explain the period or context in your notes. One observation per plan per day is retained. This does not automatically update the student record.
impact.followupInvalid: Check indicators, notes and date: it must fall between the baseline and today.
impact.duplicateDate: An observation already exists for this date. Choose another observed date; the existing record is retained.
impact.privacyThreshold: Only cohorts with at least {{count}} distinct students are published. Identifiers and notes are never included. Sample records are excluded.
impact.aggregateMethod: Mean observed change from each student’s latest evaluation, grouped by main support option. Combinations cannot isolate the effect of each option.
impact.suppressed: No cohorts have enough observations to publish. Small cohort sizes are not disclosed.
impact.fictionalAggregate: Fictional school example · not results from a real institution
impact.linkPlan: Use an existing plan or create one
impact.unavailableHelp: Evaluation data could not be loaded. Check the connection and that migrations 0009 and 0010 are installed in your test environment. Existing plans remain in their section.
impact.demoNotice: FICTIONAL DATA DEMO · No account needed. Changes stay on this screen and disappear on reload. No data is sent to a school and no real plans are created.
impact.demoObjective: Weekly tutoring and access to offline materials for six weeks; review attendance and assignments weekly.
impact.demoNotes: Fictional jury example. Check staff and material availability; adapt support with the student.
impact.demoExampleHelp: Enter a fictional observation or load the prepared example. Neither represents a real outcome.
impact.demoFollowupNotes: Entirely fictional observation: indicators are compared over four weeks. Change cannot be attributed to the intervention.
impact.smallGroupsHelp: Directors need at least five real students to view indicators. Small breakdowns are also hidden.
impact.deliveryNote: The app registers students, explains alerts and evaluates plans. Training, support and integrations are services to agree with the institution. The solidarity pool requires human assignment; a registered license does not automatically create or enable school accounts.

tutoring.objective: Address specific learning difficulties with personalized tutoring.
tutoring.resources: A teacher or tutor, a weekly session and adapted materials.
tutoring.indicators: Average grade, attendance and submissions at baseline and each review.

resources.objective: Reduce connectivity and learning-material access barriers.
resources.resources: A loan device if available, printed materials or previously downloaded content.
resources.indicators: Submissions and resource access; confirm barriers with the student.

family.objective: Agree on follow-up with the family or caregivers, adapted to their situation.
family.resources: Tutor time and a school-authorized communication channel.
family.indicators: Attendance and submissions; record agreements without sensitive family details.

mentoring.objective: Strengthen subject knowledge and study habits with academic support.
mentoring.resources: Reinforcement sessions, graded exercises and teacher coordination.
mentoring.indicators: Average grade and submissions; document the period and topics covered.
